title: Google sign-in, calendar and contacts
steps: ⌘⇧P, Show calendar: the next two weeks, from the recorded sample calendar (this Preview has no Google account). The standup repeats, and ↻ marks its occurrences; one was cancelled and doesn't show.
⌘⇧P, Show contacts, and type in the search box: Ada, Sam, or an email.
Both are panels, so they open in windows too: drag the panel's title into a window, or Open Calendar in a window.
Agents get the same data: the MCP tools list_events and list_contacts, or `curl <this Preview>/api/events`.
Google sign-in itself runs in production only: a Preview opens signed in as a dev user, as before. Sign out is in ⌘⇧P.
